headline: Signs You Need Professional Garage Fire Restoration
articleBody: It can be tough to decide if your garage fire damage is something you can handle yourself or if you really need a professional touch. But certain signs definitely point to needing expert help. If you're noticing a persistent smoke odor that just won't go away, even after airing out the garage, that's a key indicator; it means smoke has deeply penetrated materials. Visible soot staining on walls, tools, or stored items is another clear sign that professional cleaning methods are necessary to prevent permanent discoloration. Any structural damage, like compromised studs or joists, absolutely requires expert assessment for safety reasons. If there's water damage from firefighting efforts, you'll need prompt professional water extraction and drying to avoid mold and further deterioration. Ultimately, if the scope of the damage feels overwhelming, or you're unsure about the safest and most effective way to clean, it’s time to call in the professionals. First To Respond Restoration has over 25 years of experience dealing with fire and smoke damage, and we’re ready to help you recover.
